scripts.check: bun run verify:generated && bun run test:core && bun build ./app.js --target=browser --outdir=/tmp/argiope-palettes-check
scripts.check:editors: bun run check && bun run verify:neovim && bun run verify:helix && bun run verify:zed && bun run test:neovim
scripts.verify:generated: bun run build:neovim && bun run build:helix && bun run build:zed && git diff --exit-code -- dist/argiope-themes.lua dist/helix dist/zed
scripts.verify:helix: bun run sync:helix && git -C editors/helix diff --exit-code -- themes runtime/queries languages.toml
scripts.verify:zed: bun run sync:zed && git -C editors/zed diff --exit-code -- themes/argiope.json languages
scripts.verify:neovim: bun run sync:neovim && git -C editors/neovim diff --exit-code -- lua/argiope/generated/themes.lua
